summary: List the objects under one prefix of one bucket.

prefix.describe: the key prefix; policy narrows it with a prefix constraint. Required so the flag never dangles; may be empty.

layer2.enforced_by: IAM. Without Tower: the access key in the vault belongs to a principal whose policy allows s3:ListBucket on the named buckets and nothing else. With Tower (an STS seed in the vault): the seed can only sts:AssumeRole into the role in `aws`, and every operation runs under a 900-second session whose policy names this one bucket and this one prefix - narrower than the role, and the role is still the ceiling.
layer2.check: aws s3api put-object --bucket <b> --key x --body /dev/null  ->  AccessDenied; aws iam list-users  ->  AccessDenied; with a session from `tower`: aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket <other-bucket>  ->  AccessDenied
